criteria_details.match: partial: target_met is false. Strong pieces: side 0.819 per taker order vs 0.538 market-only; presence AUC 0.867 with permutation p = 0.0005; PnL rotation p = 0.00025. But the presence / selection gain over a market-activity baseline is +0.011 / +0.018 (< 0.05), the PnL correlation is 0.42 / 0.41 (< 0.5) and XM fails replication.
criteria_details.backtest: fail: the executable rule (exposure tracker mix14, strict fills against other traders' taker prints, latency >= 2 s after the information horizon) returns -0.98% before rebates on $154k bought (block-bootstrap P(return <= 0) = 0.77, 95% CI [-3.6%, +1.7%]); with print stamps >= s+3 (block-time slack 2 s) -2.39% (P = 0.945); capture 0.5 -1.1% / -2.5%; the 30-share replica -2.33%. A 50% fee rebate (not available to a newcomer at the 0% tier) gives +0.56% (P(<= 0) = 0.33), still not significant.
criteria_details.replicable: fail: the edge needs a host next to Polymarket's London engine reading Binance spot within ~100 ms, inside a 150-ms taker hold (placebo anchors m +-3 s give 50% side accuracy); a normal connection at >= 2 s loses 1-2.4% before rebates; at the observed liquidity the rule trades ~$1.2M a month for about -$11k a month, nowhere near $50k/month profit.
criteria_details.persists: fail: the deploy-now statement is not supported. The deployable rule loses on the newest lot days (10-27 -3.2%, 10-29 +1.1%, neither significant). The wallets themselves still earn (assess_persistence as of 11-01: GF and DS recent 30 days p < 1e-4, no decline; XM late-15-day decline p = 0.0018), and the conditions they need (150-ms taker delay, 50% taker rebate paid daily, BTC 5m listings) held on the lot, but that is the operator's colocated, rebate-tier edge, not a normal user's.

rule_summary: Frozen iteration-14 rule (code/final_rule.py sha256 0523a66c...): presence on Polygon block seconds = LightGBM model_it5_blk_full (spot 1-s closes <= s-2, venue trades < s-1, others' prints <= s-1); side = dc_exam14 (Binance spot microprice / trade returns over 100-2000 ms ending 260 ms before the capture match ms, model_it14_dcside_spot); price = the touch of the same match; PnL rule = exposure tracker buying the deficit to a predicted cluster net-flow target (0.5 x (it4b + nf12b)/2 + 0.5 x 5.935 x hazard imbalance) at last implied ask + 2 c, strict fills against other traders' taker BUY prints stamped [s+1, s+3].

leakage_check.details: No sealed access by development code: guards in every archive / capture loader (end_ts <= H, d0 + 86400 > H refused unless allow_sealed), a scan of .cache/re/btc5m-bot found no file with data in [H, T0) (79 files past H, all in the development blocks 10-31 00-06 / 12-18), no reads of .cache/live/sealed/, http.sqlite or other workspaces, Gamma kept only for development windows (outcome column named SETTLEMENT_ONLY). Every rule parameter is a module constant; models are frozen files dated before the exam. Truncation / corruption tests at the code's stated horizons: 960 / 960 identical (blk_full, blk_pure, dp_full, netflow; 12 seeded windows x 20 decision seconds), side route 300 / 300 and hazard 200 / 200 identical. FAILED item: the pre-registered block-second presence unit uses data inside the 2-s block-time slack (prints stamped s-1, venue trades in [s-2, s-1) for a fill stamped s that matched up to 2 s earlier): corrupting that slice changes 480 / 480 sampled predictions (mean |dp| 0.178). The slack-clean decision-aligned unit is reported (0.905 vs 0.877). Also: W4 / W5 (the operator's own fan-out wallets) prints count as market activity in the tape features (8% of block cells, 19.9% of positives; excluding those cells leaves the gain over MSB at +0.012); the hazard's Polymarket inputs end 55-105 ms after the decision (in both model and baseline); nf12b's prev_up_spot reads the close of start-1 at rel 0-1 (<= 1 s early). None of these changes the verdict.

why_it_works: Latency arbitrage of stale Polymarket asks inside the 150-ms taker hold, paid for by slow makers and by the 50% taker-fee rebate. The bot reads the Binance spot book ~100 ms after its stamp next to Polymarket's engine and lifts the outcome the spot microprice is moving toward (82% of taker orders on the lot vs 54% for any market-only rule). It buys both outcomes of 98% of windows: 88.6% of shares end paired at a pair cost of 0.9795, locking $26.5k gross on the lot; after $32.3k of taker fees its trading PnL is +$13.1k (+0.92% of $1.42M); the next-day 50% taker rebate (+$16.2k) doubles that (+2.05%). Its taker fills earn ~0 after fees (+0.03 c / share); its maker fills (26% of USDC, mostly lost races resting at the old ask) earn +1.66 c / share. Who loses: makers whose asks still stand when the hold ends (the slowest quote-pullers), and Polymarket's rebate pool.

deploy_now.evidence: The executable rule loses before rebates on the lot (-0.98%, P(<= 0) = 0.77; -2.39% with block-time slack) and on the newest days (10-27 -3.2%, 10-29 +1.1%); a newcomer has a 0% rebate tier, and even a 50% rebate leaves it insignificant (+0.56%, P = 0.33). The wallets' own edge persists (GF / DS recent 30 days p < 1e-4; XM recent p = 0.0017 but late-15-day decline p = 0.0018) because of colocation, queue position and the Obsidian rebate tier, none of which a normal user has.
